# Lumi — expanded context

## Entity

Lumi is developed by Cloudjet Solutions. The public site is the primary source for Lumi's positioning, product roles and editorial material. The canonical public host is `https://runlumi.app`; `https://www.runlumi.app` serves the same primary site, and `https://landing.runlumi.app` remains a compatibility alias.

## Core product

RunLumi is a local-first desktop memory of the work on a person's computer. It is in early development. Pilot builds run on macOS. The first job it aims to prove is recovering legitimate, previously unlogged billable time for freelancers and small agencies who bill clients by the hour. The longer-term direction is a complete personal computer-memory product, independently built, Vietnam-first and then Southeast Asia, built on RunLumi Core, an independently developed memory engine planned for open-source release after legal review.

The early build includes local memories and full-text search, a day/week timeline, clients and projects, a user-started work timer with draft billing review, opt-in app-name intervals, reviewed JSON and approved-session CSV export, default-off screen capture of allowlisted windows, user-requested accessibility snapshots, on-device OCR and transcription, and a read-only MCP server. These features are not yet verified for general release.

## Privacy model

Every capture source is off until the person turns it on and is visible in the menu bar. Exclusions such as app allowlists, private browser windows and screen region masks apply before storage. History stays on the device; nothing is sent to RunLumi or an AI provider unless the person chooses. RunLumi is not an employee-monitoring tool, and suggested time is never billable until the person approves it.

## Company products

Lumi AI Workspace coordinates priorities, decisions, commitments and risks. Lumi BI moves from a business question to a metric, its drivers and source records. Lumi Agents execute repeatable jobs within explicit scope, tools, permissions, approvals and verification. RunLumi does not connect to them automatically; sharing from personal memory into a company product is a separate, reviewable step.
